featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Natikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had our maternity photoshoot with The Shivay Photo, and the entire experience was wonderful from start to finish. The team was extremely professional, patient, and supportive throughout the shoot. They created such a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere that my wife and I felt completely at ease in front of the camera.

Their attention to detail, creativity, and ability to capture beautiful emotions truly reflect their skill and passion for photography. Every pose, suggestion, and interaction felt natural and thoughtful. We especially appreciate how caring and helpful the team was in ensuring my wife was comfortable during the entire session.

Thank you, The Shivay Photo, for giving us such beautiful memories to cherish forever. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for a professional, friendly, and talented photography team.

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Shivay Photo and their incredible crew — Sejal, Mitesh, Aakash, and Shivam. From start to finish, they made us feel comfortable, relaxed, and genuinely cared for.

As a pregnant woman, I especially appreciated how patient and considerate the team was throughout the shoot. They never rushed us, ensured I was comfortable at every step, and gave us enough time to enjoy the experience rather than making it feel like a task to complete.

Their professionalism, attention to detail, and ability to capture natural moments made the entire shoot memorable. The crew brought great energy, guided us effortlessly, and created a calm environment that allowed us to be ourselves.

If you’re looking for a team that combines talent with genuine warmth and care, Shivay Photo is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Nehal Mutha
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience working with the maternity shoot team! Everything was so beautifully coordinated and smooth right from the beginning. From helping us select outfits and themes to the makeup and hairstyle, every detail was thoughtfully managed and made stress-free for us.
What we especially loved was that even the outdoor shoot locations were connected to the property where the indoor setups were located, which made it extremely comfortable and convenient for an expecting mom without too much movement or travel.
And of course, the photography was simply wonderful — the team made us feel so comfortable and captured such beautiful memories that we’ll cherish forever. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a seamless, comfortable, and memorable maternity shoot experience!

featured_reviews.name: Lina
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience with the entire team. The photos were captured beautifully with great attention to detail and creativity. Mitesh and team are professional, punctual, friendly, and made us feel comfortable throughout the shoot. Mrinal did an excellent job of giving me thr perfect look for the shoot. The final pictures exceeded our expectations and perfectly captured all the special moments. Highly recommended for anyone looking for high-quality photography services!

featured_reviews.name: Harshika Bhandari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had an incredible maternity photoshoot at Malad Studio, and the experience was seamless from start to finish.
They made me feel completely at ease and confident, which truly showed in the results. The team guided us through natural, flattering poses, and the studio setup—with its soft, beautiful lighting—was perfect. The final photos are stunning: warm, intimate, and a perfect reflection of our joy. If you want to celebrate this milestone with a team that cares about the details, I highly recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: deep thaker
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of doing a maternity photoshoot, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience! From start to finish, everything was handled with care and professionalism.

I would like to thank Mr. Shivay, Ms. Het, Mr. Sagar and his team along with Mr. Jay who were so co-operative, very warm and helpful throughout this entire journey.

The Entire team at Malad Studio made us feel so comfortable and confident, which is so important during this special time. They guided my wife through poses that felt natural and flattering, and the attention to detail was incredible.

The setup was beautiful, with soft lighting that perfectly captured the essence of motherhood. The final photos were stunning—warm, intimate, and full of emotion. They truly reflected the joy and anticipation of this journey.

If you’re considering a maternity shoot, I highly recommend it. It’s a beautiful way to celebrate this milestone and create memories you’ll cherish forever.

featured_reviews.name: swapnali rakshe
featured_reviews.review_text: Stunning work! The shivay photo is professional, incredibly talented, and made our maternity session so much wonderful. The pictures are absolutely amazing and we will treasure them forever. Thank you for capturing our growing family so beautifully!

featured_reviews.name: Dhiraj Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience with Shivay Photography Team. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and seamless coordination truly stood out throughout the entire process.

The team was extremely supportive, patient, and ensured that every moment was captured beautifully. Their creative vision and dedication reflect in the quality of their work, and I’m genuinely impressed with their approach and execution.

Thank you once again for your efforts and commitment. I’m looking forward to seeing the final output and would definitely recommend your team to anyone looking for a reliable and talented photography partner.
